Module com.stockle
Package com.stockle.api.service

Class HistoricalDataService

java.lang.Object
com.stockle.api.service.HistoricalDataService
public class HistoricalDataService extends Object
Service for retrieving historical market data from the Alpaca API. Provides methods to get historical bar data (ohlcv), quote data (bid/ask), and trade data for stocks within specified date ranges and timeframes. Supports pagination for large datasets.

  • Method Details

    • getHistoricalBars

      public List<BarData> getHistoricalBars(String symbol, String startDate, String endDate, String timeframe, String feed)
      Retrieves historical bar data (ohlcv) for a stock within a date range. gets historical bars (open, high, low, close, volume) for the specified symbol and timeframe from the Alpaca API. Automatically handles pagination to retrieve all available data up to a maximum of 100 pages.
      Parameters:
      symbol - the stock symbol (e.g., "AAPL")
      startDate - the start date for the historical data (inclusive)
      endDate - the end date for the historical data (inclusive)
      timeframe - the bar timeframe (e.g., "1Min", "5Min", "1Hour", "1Day")
      feed - the market data feed to use (e.g., "sip" or "iex")
      Returns:
      a list of BarData objects representing historical bars

    • getHistoricalQuotes

      public List<QuoteData> getHistoricalQuotes(String symbol, String startDate, String endDate, String feed)
      Retrieves historical quote data (bid/ask) for a stock within a date range. gets historical quotes including bid/ask prices and sizes for the specified symbol from the Alpaca API. Automatically handles pagination to retrieve all available data up to a maximum of 10 pages.
      Parameters:
      symbol - the stock symbol (e.g., "AAPL")
      startDate - the start date for the historical data (inclusive)
      endDate - the end date for the historical data (inclusive)
      feed - the market data feed to use (e.g., "sip" or "iex")
      Returns:
      a list of QuoteData objects representing historical quotes

    • getHistoricalTrades

      public List<TradeData> getHistoricalTrades(String symbol, String startDate, String endDate, String feed)
      Retrieves historical trade data for a stock within a date range. gets historical trade records including price, size, and exchange for the specified symbol from the Alpaca API. Automatically handles pagination to retrieve all available data up to a maximum of 100 pages.
      Parameters:
      symbol - the stock symbol (e.g., "AAPL")
      startDate - the start date for the historical data (inclusive)
      endDate - the end date for the historical data (inclusive)
      feed - the market data feed to use (e.g., "sip" or "iex")
      Returns:
      a list of TradeData objects representing historical trades
